newsitem.title: USA: USDA begins weekly steer/heifer price report.
newsitem.headline: USDA begins weekly steer/heifer price report.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department began a new report Monday on slaughter steer and heifer prices.
The weekly report by USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service gives premium/discount prices for different qualities, grade yields and weight ranges.
It was the second new report begun by USDA aimed at increasing information in livestock markets, following a recent report by USDA's committee on concentration in the livestock industry.
On Friday, USDA began a weekly report on the number of contract cattle traded in the previous week.
